errors.selection_unlocated: Could not locate the selection in the source. Select the text again.
errors.selection_too_large: The selection and its paragraph are too long. Select less text and try again.
errors.literature_missing: The literature item is unavailable. Reopen it and try again.
errors.document_too_large: Document processing exceeded a limit. Retry to obtain the specific cause.
errors.file_too_large: This document-level operation supports PDFs up to 30 MiB. Use a smaller document; figure explanations are not subject to this file-size limit.
errors.input_too_large: The analysis input exceeds the processing budget. Reduce the selection or input; for full-document interpretation, try a longer-context model.
errors.source_changed: The source PDF has changed. Reopen it and try again.
errors.page_out_of_range: The page number is outside the document.
errors.region_required: Select a figure or table on the current page.
errors.region_out_of_range: The selected region extends beyond the page. Select it again.
errors.region_too_small: The selected region is too small. Select a clear figure or table.
errors.region_missing: The selected formula, figure, or table region is unavailable. Select it again.
errors.module_unsupported: The interpretation module is not supported.
errors.result_rejected: The model could not process this content. Try again or choose another model.
errors.translation_language_invalid: The model did not return a valid detected source language. Try again.
errors.translation_direction_mismatch: The returned target language does not match your selection. Try again.
errors.translation_incomplete: The translation does not cover every page. Previous results are preserved. Use a model with a larger output capacity.
errors.translation_content_missing: The translation contains empty pages or missing paragraphs. Try again.
errors.interpretation_incomplete: The interpretation is incomplete. Previous results are preserved.
errors.summary_fields_missing: The summary is missing the paper type or key claims. Try again.
errors.summary_structure_invalid: The summary structure is incomplete. Try again.
errors.result_empty: The model did not return a valid result. Try again.
errors.translation_alignment_missing: The translation is missing sentence pairs. Try again.
errors.translation_sentence_incomplete: The sentence translation is incomplete. Try again.
errors.task_unresolved: The translation task status could not be confirmed. Automatic retries have paused to avoid duplicate generation. Check the result after the service recovers.
errors.pdf_input_unsupported: The current model does not declare PDF input support. Check its capabilities in model settings or select another model.
errors.image_input_unsupported: The current model does not declare image input support. Select a model that supports images.
errors.generation_failed: Generation failed. Check the model connection and try again.
errors.literature_deleted: The literature item was deleted. This result will not be saved.
errors.source_changed_during_generation: The source PDF changed during generation. Previous results are preserved. Reopen the literature item.
errors.execution_failed: Generation failed. Previous results are preserved. Try again.
errors.preparation_failed: Could not prepare the reading task. Check the document and model settings, then try again.
errors.model_unavailable: The selected model is unavailable. Sign in or configure and select an available model in Settings → Model services.
errors.operation_busy: This operation already has a generation task. Other AI operations are still available.
errors.figure_stream_required: Figure explanation requires the streaming endpoint. Update the client and try again.
errors.source_invalid: Select a valid project PDF file for figure explanation.
